| [`vl_fused_add_rms_norm`](vl_fused_add_rms_norm.md) | DPP wave reduction in place of cub's bpermute tree on a 16-wave fused add + RMSNorm row kernel | one workgroup per row, block 1024 always full, cub BlockReduce lowered to 6 ds_bpermute_b32 + lgkmcnt(0) per wave and a 4-step bpermute second level in wave 0, two barriers; … |
| [`vl_moe_align`](vl_moe_align.md) | Wave-contiguous multi-KB reads with one cache line per lane | Considering letting each lane read several consecutive 16-byte vectors so a wave covers 8 KB contiguously. |
| [`vl_rms_norm`](vl_rms_norm.md) | coarsen on an 8-wave row kernel at the floor | one workgroup per row, 8 waves, one barrier, 16384 workgroups, headroom ~1.1 |
| [`vl_rms_norm`](vl_rms_norm.md) | Two rows per 1024-thread workgroup in parallel on a 4 KB-row normalisation kernel | One row per 16-wave workgroup, one barrier, input kept in registers; idea is to halve workgroups and barriers without serialising rows as coarsen does |
| [`vl_rotary_embedding`](vl_rotary_embedding.md) | Cold in-place loads issued before the scalar wait for the row index | Per-token kernel whose data addresses do not depend on a scalar-loaded index (positions[token]) but whose cached table loads do; prologue is scalar loads and about 60 SALU, no heavy math; headroom about 0.95 |
| [`vl_rotary_embedding`](vl_rotary_embedding.md) | Smaller workgroups on a per-token kernel with a heavy per-wave prologue | amdclang build launched as one multi-wave workgroup per token (block 640) whose code takes its stride from gridDim.y*blockDim.x, so relaunch alone changes the split; each wave pays 10 scalar loads and a per-lane division |
| [`vl_rotary_embedding`](vl_rotary_embedding.md) | Flat row-spanning 1024-thread workgroups with a per-lane metadata load | One workgroup per row (token) smaller than 1024 threads, a per-row scalar (`s_load_dwordx2` of positions[row]) feeding the addresses of cold loads; the idea is to flatten (row, group) so workgroups are full |
| [`vl_rotary_embedding`](vl_rotary_embedding.md) | Block rounded up to 1024 with idle waves | Per-row work fills fewer waves than the block (here 10 of 16); waves beyond the work exit at the bounds mask |
| [`vl_rotary_embedding`](vl_rotary_embedding.md) | Two 16-byte groups per thread on an in-place rotate (32 B per lane) | Elementwise in-place kernel already moving 16 B per lane per stream with x4 loads, at headroom about 1.0 |
